name: WHO Reporting System for Soft Tissue Cytopathology
specimen: FNAB of soft tissue (and bone where applicable)
use: Soft tissue masses; superficial and deep.
report_structure: Diagnosis/pattern (spindle, round, epithelioid, pleomorphic, myxoid, lipomatous)

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: No numeric criteria; representative lesional cells; cell block for IHC/FISH.

categories.name: Insufficient / Inadequate / Non-diagnostic

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – single 828-patient report

categories.management: Repeat FNAB/core or surgical biopsy; refer to sarcoma centre if clinically suspicious (deep, >5 cm).
criteria: Scant/acellular, blood only, necrosis only, fat only from a non-lipomatous lesion.

diagnoses.name: Non-diagnostic – scant/necrotic material
diagnoses.final: Insufficient/Inadequate/Non-diagnostic (WHO Soft Tissue System). Non-diagnostic – scant/necrotic material.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Soft Tissue System – Insufficient/Inadequate/Non-diagnostic

categories.name: Benign
categories.definition: Specific benign lesion or benign process.

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text

criteria: Lipoma, schwannoma, nodular fasciitis, granular cell tumour, ganglion, fat necrosis, abscess, fibromatosis-free benign lesions, giant cell tumour of tendon sheath.

diagnoses.name: Lipoma
diagnoses.final: Benign (WHO Soft Tissue System). Lipoma.
diagnoses.comment: Mature adipocytes; correlate with size/depth (atypical lipomatous tumour may look identical; MDM2 FISH if deep/large).
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Soft Tissue System – Benign

categories.name: Atypical
categories.definition: Atypia insufficient for more specific category; often limited cellularity.

rom.value: 39.6% overall (lipomatous 3% to myxoid 84.6%); 46% in another study
rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text

criteria: Atypical spindle/round/epithelioid cells, few in number.

diagnoses.name: Atypical spindle cells
diagnoses.final: Atypical (WHO Soft Tissue System). Atypical spindle cells.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Soft Tissue System – Atypical

categories.name: Soft tissue neoplasm of uncertain malignant potential
categories.definition: Neoplasm identified but malignant potential cannot be determined on cytology (benign vs low-grade sarcoma), or intermediate (locally aggressive/rarely metastasising) entities.

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – single 2,214-case study

criteria: Low-grade spindle/myxoid neoplasms; desmoid fibromatosis; solitary fibrous tumour; cellular schwannoma vs MPNST uncertain.

diagnoses.name: Low-grade spindle cell neoplasm
diagnoses.final: STNUMP (WHO Soft Tissue System). Low-grade spindle cell neoplasm.
diagnoses.comment: Benign vs low-grade sarcoma cannot be distinguished; histology needed.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Soft Tissue System – STNUMP

diagnoses.name: Myxoid neoplasm (myxoma vs myxofibrosarcoma vs myxoid liposarcoma)
diagnoses.final: STNUMP (WHO Soft Tissue System). Myxoid neoplasm (myxoma vs myxofibrosarcoma vs myxoid liposarcoma).
diagnoses.comment: Correlate with imaging; sarcoma MDT discussion recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Soft Tissue System – STNUMP

categories.definition: Unequivocal malignancy; specify type (sarcoma by grade/type where possible; or carcinoma, melanoma, lymphoma).

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text

criteria: High-grade pleomorphic sarcoma, round cell sarcomas (Ewing, rhabdomyosarcoma, synovial), myxoid liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, metastases.
